name: Viha Dikonda
why: Viha is the presenter in 70% of posts — the child-led format behind LJ-004 (the account's best ad, ₹140 per purchase) and LJ-050.
Her single most-played recent post is Viha trying to speak Hindi in a Telugu accent (6.5M plays), so a Hinglish script plays to an existing strength.
She already films Viha eating and reacting to food (e.g. the restaurant spicy-food reaction, 3.3M plays).

She has worked with Little Joys before: the audience file lists it among her past-year brands. No ad in this export names her, so whichever ad that was cannot be identified here; ask the brand team how it performed before booking.
Followers 827,496; typical video reach 771k-3,096k plays (middle half of their last 16 videos).
risks: Her audience is only 30% women (70% men; largest age group 25-34, at 44%). The buyer is usually a mother, so a large share of her reach may never buy. This is the only one of the five with audience data, so it is shown as a risk, not scored. Ask for her current audience split before booking.
hook: Viha, to camera, holding her plate, in her Telugu-accented Hinglish: "Aaj dekho meri plate mein kya kya hai!" On screen: "Viha ki roti mein ek secret hai 🤫". Spoken and on-screen together, as LJ-004 opened.
script: Viha with her lunch plate, spoken + text hook (above).
Cut to Mom's hands adding one scoop of Proteinmix to the atta; Viha peeks in suspiciously.
Viha bites the roti, does her signature exaggerated chewing face, then: "Taste toh bilkul same hai!" This is the core moment — a real child genuinely tasting on camera.
Mom voiceover (Hinglish): 12g plant protein in one scoop, from pea, brown rice and soy; no change in taste.
Viha asks for a second roti; packshot with "Little Joys Proteinmix" on screen.

avoid: An adult script read by Viha about nutrients (her profile: an adult reading marketing copy feels foreign).

Height / 'overall growth' promises and deficiency fear (both did worse in the ads).

Telugu as the only version — no Telugu ad has ever been tested; regional-language ads cost 47% more per purchase after adjustment.

Individual lookalike ads ranged from ₹140 to ₹1,050: execution matters as much as the recipe. Most of the advantage over the account average comes from Proteinmix itself being cheap to sell; the format adds about 10% on top. Read this as a direction, not a forecast.
Organic reach: their typical video gets 771k-3,096k plays; too few sponsored videos to say whether sponsored posts get fewer plays.
